name: Doctor Strange
title: Master of the Mystic Arts & Sorcerer Supreme
lore: Guardian of the Sanctum Sanctorum and wielder of ancient Eldritch incantations. In the Mirror Dimension, Doctor Strange bends the laws of physics, summoning mystical mandalas, astral force punches, and dimensional rifts to control space and keep foes at bay.

moves.name: Eldritch Strike (5A)
moves.description: Quick forward palm thrust infused with purple mystical runes. Excellent poke and combo starter.

moves.name: Astral Punch (5B)
moves.description: Stepping forward strike focusing Eldritch rings around the knuckles, causing cosmic pushback.

moves.name: Mystic Thrust (6B)
moves.description: Long-reaching lunging astral strike that pierces through midrange pokes.

moves.name: Flames of the Faltine (5C)
moves.description: Summons expanding mystic mandalas from both hands, unleashing a fiery mystical blast that wallbounces.

moves.name: Seraphim Sweep (2D)
moves.description: Low mystical sweep with cloak flourish that trips standing opponents.

moves.name: Levitation Strike (8A)
moves.description: Mid-air palm thrust with flowing Cloak of Levitation momentum.

moves.name: Vapors of Valtorr (8C)
moves.description: Airborne downward mystic blast sending airborne foes crashing into the floor.

moves.name: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak (Special Projectile)
moves.description: Conjures a mystical portal projectile that travels across the arena, entrapping and blasting the opponent.

moves.name: Shield of the Seraphim (Anti-Air Special)
moves.description: Angles a mystic energy shield upwards to obliterate jumping attackers with celestial force.

moves.name: Mirror Dimension Shatter (Super)
moves.description: Doctor Strange's ultimate incantation. Channels the power of the Vishanti and shatters reality itself for devastating damage.
